'''Jeslor Salaktori''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and the [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|chief executive officer]] of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] chapter [[House Salaktori]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Salaktori inherited leadership of the chapter by right of birth, and ruled the guild in a ruthless manner, although he outwardly portrayed himself as a friendly philanthropist. He oversaw the destruction of three minor house rivals and he strove to be able to pass on a far stronger guild to whichever of his children he chose to appoint as his heir than he had inherited himself. Salaktori employed an [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] to act as his [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]], which was disguised as a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol unit]].
